summary: First-iteration full-stack testing of Kript (ZK password manager, Spanish UI). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass — health, auth (register/login/me/logout/bearer/cookie), credentials CRUD with user isolation, generator with all charset combinations, Spanish error messages, no _id leakage. Frontend: 10/10 critical Playwright checks pass — landing in Spanish with proper navy/lime/sky palette (no purple), login (wrong + correct creds), redirect to /app, new-credential modal opens, generator page, settings shows admin email, logout, ProtectedRoute redirect.

minor.issue: Stale CORS_ORIGINS="*" key in .env is unused (server reads FRONTEND_URL). Harmless but misleading.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on /api/auth/login (playbook recommends 5-attempt lockout). Acceptable for MVP demo but should be noted.

issues: CATEGORÍA uses native HTML <select> instead of shadcn Select component — breaks the dark-themed visual language (renders as default browser dropdown). Recommend swapping to shadcn Select for consistency.

action_items: (Optional) Replace native <select> for category with shadcn Select in CredentialModal.jsx for theme consistency.
(Optional) Remove unused CORS_ORIGINS="*" from /app/backend/.env to avoid confusion.
(Optional / future) Add login rate-limit + lockout per playbook.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — works but should migrate to lifespan handlers.
server.py: cookies use SameSite=None+Secure unconditionally — fine for the HTTPS preview origin, would block localhost http during dev.
server.py: imports `secrets` and `string` mid-file (line 301) — minor style issue; move to top.
server.py: passwords stored on credentials are plaintext in Mongo — explicitly intentional per user request, but should add a TODO/comment in code so future devs don't ship as-is.
Single-file backend (~370 lines) is acceptable now; split into routers/ + auth.py if it grows past ~700 lines.
test_credentials: admin@kript.app / admin123 (seeded). Dynamic test users created with email test+{ms-timestamp}@example.com.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — credentials created in tests are deleted in teardown. Each test run creates one new throwaway user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_kript_api.py is the regression baseline (15 cases). Reuse `requests.Session` to keep httpOnly cookies. Use unique email per run (test+{timestamp}@example.com) — admin user is idempotent because seed_admin updates pwd if changed. Mongo collections: users, credentials. UUID ids; _id is excluded everywhere.
